{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    if: false # Temporarily disabled due to golangci-lint config issues
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "stable"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          else
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          fi

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          version: v2.1.0
          args: --timeout=5m

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "stable"

      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: |
          if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          else
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          fi
          go build -v ./cmd/dnsmonster

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test -v -race -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic ./...

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          files: ./coverage.out
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    needs: [lint, test]
    steps:
      - name: Set up Go 1.x
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "stable"

      - name: Check out code into the Go module directory
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: |
          if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          else
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          fi
          go build -v ./cmd/dnsmonster

      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./cmd/dnsmonster

      - name: generate sample config file
        run: ./dnsmonster --writeConfig=config-sample.ini

      - name: update README command line options
        run: |
          START="$(($(grep -n "start of command line options" README.md | cut -f1 -d:)+2))"
          END="$(($(grep -n "end of command line options" README.md | cut -f1 -d:)-2))"
          USAGE=$(cat <<-END
          $(./dnsmonster --writeConfig /dev/stdout | sed -E 's/^;/#/; s/^\\w/--\\l&/; s/^\\[/# \\[/; s/ =.?/=/; s/=false|stderr//')
          END
          )
          awk -v var="$USAGE" 'NR=='$START'{print var} NR<'$START' || NR>'$END README.md > README.tmp
          mv README.tmp README.md
        working-directory: "."

      - name: Commit changes
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }} # only commit changes if it's a push to branch not a PR
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v11
        with:
          author_name: Ali Mosajjal
          author_email: mosajjal@gmail.com
          message: "auto update sample ini"
          add: "config-sample.ini README.md"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dnsmonster-linux-amd64.bin
          path: ./dnsmonster

  security:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "stable"

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          else
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y libpcap-dev
          fi
      - name: Run Gosec Security Scanner
        uses: securego/gosec@v2.30.0
        with:
          args: "-no-fail -fmt sarif -out results.sarif ./..."

      - name: Upload SARIF file
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v4
        with:
          sarif_file: results.sarif

      - name: Run govulncheck
        run: |
          go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.1.3
          govulncheck ./...",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Go project with go.mod/go.sum present, and several active jobs (test, build, security) repeatedly fetch/build Go dependencies. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern, supported by the measured experiment example, shows adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on go.mod/go.sum reduces job time while preserving all build/test steps. I add a Cache Go modules step after checkout in each active dependency-installing job, leaving the disabled lint job and all test/coverage/security steps unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
